paragraphs: The X5 xDrive30d has been a mainstay of the X5 diesel range since 2013, spanning two generations under one badge. The F15 generation (2013–2018) uses the N57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel well-regarded in its era, though turbo actuator wear is a documented pattern on this engine. From 2018, the G05-generation xDrive30d switched to the B57, the newer B-series generation diesel that's generally considered reliable and doesn't share the N57's documented wear pattern. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components, the known wear pattern, and even the rebuild specifics differ between them — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 xDrive30d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the X5 xDrive30d from 2013 to 2018. Turbo actuator wear is a documented pattern on this engine. We inspect and replace worn turbo components and timing chain components as standard on every N57 rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your N57 BMW X5 xDrive30d

cards.body: The current 3.0-litre inline-six diesel, fitted from 2018. The B-series generation is generally reliable, with no documented major defect pattern specific to this application. We service it to the same standard as our other X5 xDrive30d rebuilds.
cards.cta: Check Your B57 BMW X5 xDrive30d

compatibility.intro: Because the X5 xDrive30d spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an N57 part will work on a B57 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N57 or B57) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X5 xDrive30d quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
